name: The Verona Crossbody
tagline: Architectural silhouette meets effortless everyday grace
description: Crafted from hand-selected full-grain vegetable-tanned leather in our Tuscan atelier, The Verona is sculpted with crisp bevelled corners, hand-painted edges, and a signature interlocking brass turn-lock clasp. Sized perfectly to carry your smartphone, compact wallet, keys, and lip treatment.
details: Magnetic flap closure with custom solid brass turn-lock
Interior slip pocket and zip compartment with leather pull
Exterior discreet slip pocket for passport or transit card
Reinforced base with four protective brass feet
Supplied in a bespoke organic cotton dust bag
care: Store in the provided dust bag away from direct sunlight. Treat with organic leather balm twice yearly. Wipe dry immediately if exposed to rain.

name: The Céleste Structured Tote
tagline: The standard of elevated professional elegance
lining: Plush beige microsuede with leather trim
description: Architected to house a 14-inch laptop alongside daily essentials without compromising on sculptural form. The Céleste features a partitioned interior with a central padded zipped compartment, luggage sleeve, and structured rolled handles.
details: Fits up to 14" MacBook Pro comfortably
Central padded zippered compartment plus 2 open gussets
Detachable key leash with engraved brass fob
Hidden magnetic top tab closure
Dual rolled handles with reinforced core for shoulder comfort
care: Gently wipe with soft damp cloth. Condition leather periodically. Avoid overstuffing beyond recommended weight.

name: The Seraphina Baguette
tagline: Nineties minimalism reimagined in butter-soft nappa
description: The Seraphina slips effortlessly under the arm with a curved ergonomic top line. Its supple nappa leather feels like liquid silk to the touch while retaining an impeccably tailored silhouette for candlelit evenings and weekend city strolls.
details: Ultra-smooth two-way brass zip with elongated leather pullers
Interior card slot (holds up to 4 credit cards)
Sculpted shoulder strap designed to sit flat without slipping
Hand-finished lacquered edges in three coats
care: Protect against sharp jewellery and harsh perfumes. Store stuffed with acid-free tissue paper.

name: The Monaco Flap Clutch
tagline: A jewel of leather craft with a detachable jewel chain
description: Seamlessly transitions from a hand-held dinner statement to a delicate shoulder cross-body with its removable hand-linked curb chain. Stamped with fine crocodile grain and finished with hand-burnished edge lacquer.
details: Solid brass jewellery chain with leather shoulder cushion
Internal vanity mirror compartment
Six dedicated credit card slots
Discreet magnetic double clasp with tactile snap
care: Buff gently with a soft microfibre cloth. Avoid direct contact with hand sanitizers and cosmetics.

name: The Porto City Backpack
tagline: Uncompromising utility wrapped in Portuguese artisanal leather
description: Created for cultured commuters and weekend explorers. The Porto pairs a softly contoured silhouette with a secure back-panel anti-theft zip pocket, padded laptop compartment, and ergonomic leather shoulder straps.
details: Accommodates up to 13" laptops in padded rear pocket
Concealed passport pocket against your back
Adjustable ergonomic full-leather straps with shoulder padding
Drawstring top with flap lock buckle
care: Spot clean using specialist leather foam. Allow to air dry naturally.

name: The Florence Grand Weekender
tagline: The supreme companion for 72-hour European getaways
lining: Treated British twill canvas with antique gold accents
description: Hand-stitched in Florence by third-generation master artisans using 2.2mm thick vegetable-tanned leather that develops an extraordinary, one-of-a-kind golden patina over decades of travel. Meets international carry-on requirements.
details: TSA and IATA cabin approved dimensions
Reinforced double-layered bottom with five brass studs
Includes engraved brass padlock and leather key clochette
Heavy-duty YKK Excella two-way brass zip with lockable pullers
Detachable wide webbing & leather shoulder strap
care: Apply leather wax once a year to enhance water resistance. Cherish scratches as part of its living story.
